title: Neighbor From Hell Finally Get What He Deserves
description:
On May 5th, 2024. Multiple officers were dispatched to a residence regarding two hostile neighbours. On one side, the woman is mad that the man keeps putting unwanted property on her property & on the other side the man says that it isn’t her property and can put what he wants on there. The two escalated things and according to the woman, the man threatened her with a gun and said he was going to shoot her. All this took place before the man had work.
